name: status-bar
title: Status bar
description: The thin strip at the foot of an editor or tool: facts on both sides, each a button or plain text, the least important dropping out when space runs out.
docs: start and end are arrays of segments, most important first: an id, a label, an optional icon (iconOnly shows it alone), onSelect (the segment becomes a button), tooltip, ariaLabel for a fuller name, live (a change of its label is announced politely, with announcement for a longer sentence), priority and disabled. A segment without onSelect is plain text. separators draws a hairline between neighbours, as is div (a labelled region) or footer, and label names the region. The bar measures the natural width of every segment and keeps the most important ones that fit, by priority and then by position, the first of each side first: a segment leaves whole and returns when there is room again, and one that has left is inert, so Tab never reaches it. It is 28px high and uses only the border and muted tokens.
